name: A Mesh for Every Moment
title: A Mesh for Every Moment
summary: We present MEMO (a Mesh for Every MOment), a method that reconstructs the geometry of complete dynamic scenes, captured by multiple synchronized cameras, and extracts a mesh at every frame.
